<template>
  <v-container fluid class="pa-0">
    <v-row class="equal-height-row">
      <v-col cols="12" md="3">
        <v-skeleton-loader v-if="loading.summary" type="card" class="h-100" />
        <SummaryCard v-else :summary="summary" :currency="currency" class="h-100" />
      </v-col>
      <v-col cols="12" md="8">
        <v-row class="equal-height-row h-100">
          <v-col cols="12" md="4">
            <v-skeleton-loader v-if="loading.assetType" type="card" class="h-100" />
            <BreakdownChart v-else title="Asset Type" :data="assetTypeData" class="h-100" />
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" md="4">
            <v-skeleton-loader v-if="loading.assetClass" type="card" class="h-100" />
            <BreakdownChart v-else title="Asset Class" :data="assetClassData" class="h-100" />
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" md="4">
            <v-skeleton-loader v-if="loading.currency" type="card" class="h-100" />
            <BreakdownChart v-else title="Currency" :data="currencyData" class="h-100" />
          </v-col>
        </v-row>
      </v-col>
    </v-row>

    <v-row>
      <v-col cols="12">
        <v-skeleton-loader v-if="loading.summaryOverTime" type="table" />
        <SummaryOverTimeTable
          v-else-if="summaryOverTimeData"
          :lines="summaryOverTimeData.lines"
          :years="summaryOverTimeData.years"
          :currentYear="summaryOverTimeData.currentYear"
        />
      </v-col>
    </v-row>

    <v-row>
      <v-col cols="12">
        <v-skeleton-loader v-if="loading.navChart" type="card" />
        <NAVChart 
          v-else
          :initialData="navChartData" 
          @update-chart="updateNAVChart"
        />
      </v-col>
    </v-row>
  </v-container>
</template>

<script>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue'
import SummaryCard from '@/components/dashboard/SummaryCard.vue'
import BreakdownChart from '@/components/dashboard/BreakdownChart.vue'
import SummaryOverTimeTable from '@/components/dashboard/SummaryOverTimeTable.vue'
import NAVChart from '@/components/dashboard/NAVChart.vue'
// import { getDashboardData } from '@/services/api'
import { mockDashboardData } from '@/mockData'

export default {
  name: 'DashboardPage',
  components: {
    SummaryCard,
    BreakdownChart,
    SummaryOverTimeTable,
    NAVChart,
  },
  emits: ['update-page-title'],
  setup(props, { emit }) {
    const summary = ref({})
    const currency = ref('USD')
    const assetTypeData = ref({})
    const assetClassData = ref({})
    const currencyData = ref({})
    const summaryOverTimeData = ref(null)
    const navChartData = ref({})

    const loading = ref({
      summary: true,
      assetType: true,
      assetClass: true,
      currency: true,
      summaryOverTime: true,
      navChart: true,
    })

    const fetchDashboardData = async () => {
      try {
        // const [
        //   summaryResponse,
        //   assetTypeResponse,
        //   assetClassResponse,
        //   currencyResponse,
        //   summaryOverTimeResponse,
        //   navChartResponse
        // ] = await Promise.allSettled([
        //   getDashboardData('summary'),
        //   getDashboardData('asset_type'),
        //   getDashboardData('asset_class'),
        //   getDashboardData('currency'),
        //   getDashboardData('summary_over_time'),
        //   getDashboardData('nav_chart')
        // ])

        const summaryResponse = { status: 'fulfilled', value: mockDashboardData.summary }
        const assetTypeResponse = { status: 'fulfilled', value: mockDashboardData.assetTypeData }
        const assetClassResponse = { status: 'fulfilled', value: mockDashboardData.assetClassData }
        const currencyResponse = { status: 'fulfilled', value: mockDashboardData.currencyData }
        const summaryOverTimeResponse = { status: 'fulfilled', value: mockDashboardData.summaryOverTimeData }
        const navChartResponse = { status: 'fulfilled', value: mockDashboardData.navChartData }

        if (summaryResponse.status === 'fulfilled') {
          // summary.value = summaryResponse.value
          summary.value = mockDashboardData.summary
          loading.value.summary = false
        }

        if (assetTypeResponse.status === 'fulfilled') {
          // assetTypeData.value = assetTypeResponse.value
          assetTypeData.value = mockDashboardData.assetTypeData
          loading.value.assetType = false
        }

        if (assetClassResponse.status === 'fulfilled') {
          // assetClassData.value = assetClassResponse.value
          assetClassData.value = mockDashboardData.assetClassData
          loading.value.assetClass = false
        }

        if (currencyResponse.status === 'fulfilled') {
          // currencyData.value = currencyResponse.value
          currencyData.value = mockDashboardData.currencyData
          loading.value.currency = false
        }

        if (summaryOverTimeResponse.status === 'fulfilled') {
          // summaryOverTimeData.value = summaryOverTimeResponse.value
          summaryOverTimeData.value = mockDashboardData.summaryOverTimeData
          loading.value.summaryOverTime = false
        }

        if (navChartResponse.status === 'fulfilled') {
          // navChartData.value = navChartResponse.value
          navChartData.value = mockDashboardData.navChartData
          loading.value.navChart = false
        }

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching dashboard data:', error)
      }
    }

    const updateNAVChart = (params) => {
      console.log('Update NAV Chart with params:', params)
      // In the future, you'll fetch new data based on these params
      // For now, we'll just log the params
    }

    onMounted(() => {
      fetchDashboardData()
      emit('update-page-title', 'Dashboard')
    })

    return {
      summary,
      currency,
      assetTypeData,
      assetClassData,
      currencyData,
      summaryOverTimeData,
      navChartData,
      updateNAVChart,
      loading,
    }
  },
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.equal-height-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.equal-height-row > [class*='col-'] {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.equal-height-row .v-card {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
}

.h-100 {
  height: 100%;
}
</style>
